'''Gortius''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is the father of Evie and the husband of Queen Miriam.

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Gortius' first appearance is in Grand Quest - The Echoing Void. Outside the Grand Quest, Gortius makes another appearance in the cutscenes of [[House of Valen]].
